metrics.source: all original own-selected public-before/action/public-after/reward/terminal source trace events; no hidden state
metrics.public_context_hash: sha256 canonical JSON for original before image+direction+mission; equal hashes are public observation repeats, NOT evidence of same absolute pose
metrics.lag_window: within same episode, if public after-action hash at step t equals after-action hash at t-k; overlap allowed and not independent sample
metrics.cyclic_selected_actions: adjacent selected action 3 then 4 and 4 then 3; count independently of success
metrics.source_public_pickup_effect: own selected action3, before public front type 5/6/7, after front empty type1, same heading
metrics.source_public_drop_effect: own selected action4, before public front empty type1, after front type5/6/7, same heading
metrics.reversible_pair: genuine source-observed pickup effect followed by genuine source-observed drop effect within 16 selected actions in same episode; one-to-one most recent unmatched pickup, never across episode. NOT proof same object or hidden inventory.
metrics.short_reversible_pair: as above within 4 selected actions; subset of 16
metrics.first_last_half: first floor(actions/2) vs remaining selected actions, exact target visible/frame/front, goal; equal-action segment not same physical navigation
metrics.frozen_comparisons: per family, per role, per episode; MG40 memory enabled vs memory ablated and unchanged MG38/39B plus original native role outcomes
metrics.denominators: explicit counts, selected actions, real source public pickup/drop effects, genuine mission-target visibly present, exact mission front, goal episodes; no unselected action counterfactuals
